name: io.github.macphe22/bancadia-mcp
title: Bancadia MCP
description: Query Bancadia's registry of US business checking account products with structured filters.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional bearer token (e.g. 'Bearer <token>') that credits tools/call usage to your developer account. Without it, calls are anonymous and rate limited per IP. An invalid token returns 401. Obtain a token at https://bancadia.com/developer/signup.
